code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and relative neutropenia. There is also mild monocytosis and basophilia. Electrolytes, renal and liver function, and red cell indices are within normal limits. Findings may suggest underlying infection, inflammation, or bone marrow suppression; clinical correlation is recommended, especially given the patient’s advanced age and hypoxemia.
